initial_cohort.execution_order: Pin and inspect local inputs; deterministically stage owned disposable fixture/resource copies from frozen local source inputs; freeze the final staging/fixture/resource/adapter fingerprints, hidden criteria, host/model/effort and two-repetition schedule before calibration or trials. Randomize paired arm order with a recorded fixed seed. Fresh isolated contexts and disposable state separate every worker/helper/adjudicator. Workers cannot spawn children; controller-owned fact helpers implement only the recorded translation.
initial_cohort.repetitions_limit: Two fixed repetitions are a smoke-strength design choice, not a statistical quality threshold. Never add trials after seeing a result. Keep failures, ties, inaccessible resources, timeouts and skipped license/host arms in the record.
initial_cohort.calibration: Two non-product helper-agent trials, one with candidate-only marker and one baseline without it, checked by deterministic transcript assertion. Calibration proves actual arm loading/isolation for the selected adapter method, not candidate quality. Failure stops the cohort as incomplete.

resource_caps.allowed_local_processes: Only pinned inspected deterministic fixture/resource staging and assertion helpers using already-present Python/Node standard libraries and read-only Git queries. Pre-freeze owned local resource copies are permitted. No dependency/global/end-user installation or npm/npx/uv acquisition; no target application/server/container service, browser/Playwright/agent-browser, Unity CLI/Editor, credentials or external document writes. Trial network remains disabled. External acquisition/runtime requires separately recorded consent and scope.
resource_caps.enforcement: Controller counts all explicit spawned contexts and spawn/follow-up host turn requests, applies current-host interrupt and process timeouts, and checks artifact/tool counts. Up to four processing-worker continuations consume the 96-request ceiling; no worker creates further agents. Unobservable underlying API calls/tokens/cost remain unknown. Exceeded boundaries end the trial; exhausted task limits leave incomplete evidence rather than substitute success.
resource_caps.cap_scope: Task-specific proposed 60-minute comparison cohort limit; no universal workflow budget and no authority to start trials.
resource_caps.worker_timeout_scope: Whole worker-context lifetime across continuations; a follow-up does not restart the deadline.
resource_caps.owned_local_fixture_staging: Permitted before trial freeze: deterministic disposable owned fixture/package-resource copies from already acquired pinned local inputs. Staging is not dependency acquisition, a global/end-user installation or permission to execute native runtime tools.
resource_caps.underlying_llm_api_calls: Not observable; no numeric API-call promise.
resource_caps.token_and_model_cost_accounting: Record exposed usage only; unknown source/model/token cost and root orchestration overhead remain explicitly unknown.

initial_cohort.processing_baseline: The core baseline already contains the shared clarification loop derived from the inspected upstream grilling protocol. Candidate-versus-core outcomes measure only incremental external resource/adapter value. No interview-versus-no-interview, independent protocol invention or universal source-method benefit claim follows.

controller_factual_delegation.allocation: Exactly one fresh controller-owned factual helper for each P1/P2 worker: 2 fixtures x 2 arms x 2 repetitions = 8. Workers spawn no children.
controller_factual_delegation.scope: Each helper receives the same frozen fixture factual-research scope, tools and source facts under matched arm conditions, without candidate text, hidden answers, owner decisions, grading rubric or other-arm state. The matching helper output is supplied before each processing worker.
controller_factual_delegation.translation: Controller-owned pre-trial factual delegation translates the upstream conditional fresh-subagent requirement. The adapter records the translation rather than claiming literal worker-owned delegation or native Skill execution.
unsupported_conditional_paths: Unexpected factual questions requiring additional fresh research beyond the frozen helper scope have no extra allocation and receive an explicit unavailable/unsupported result.
Pre-delivered facts do not exercise asynchronous frontier progress while factual exploration is pending; no fidelity claim covers that path.
Missing required native/sibling capability remains unavailable; a missing capability cannot be silently omitted or converted into successful invocation.
controller_factual_delegation.fairness: Both core and external-resource processing arms receive equivalently scoped fresh factual research; no candidate-only factual advantage or cross-arm output reuse is permitted.

initial_cohort.adjudication: Eight fresh blind adjudicator contexts, one per fixture. Each adjudicator reads all anonymized arms and both fixed repetitions for the selected fixture, checking independently frozen criteria and per-repetition candidate-versus-core pairs. Review adjudicators assess both separate candidate arms against core. Eight jobs do not mean eight underlying model API calls.
initial_cohort.host_turn_accounting: The ceiling is 54 spawned agent contexts and 96 explicit host spawn/follow-up turn requests, with at most four continuation requests per processing worker. Spawned contexts differ from continuation turns and underlying LLM API requests. The controller counts every explicit spawn/follow-up request; retries and continuations consume the same cap. Root orchestration elapsed time counts inside the 60-minute task cap; unexposed model/token/cost telemetry and orchestration cost remain unknown rather than free.
